title: Cheechako's first day
creator_credit: Film Loft Productions and Derek W. Muirden
brief_description: Shows the debut of a polar bear cub in an Oregon zoo, his reactions to new surroundings, the subtle ways in which the mother bear cares for and trains her cub, and the ways in which these animals adapt to the urban environment. Suitable for middle and upper primary levels.
